values.text: 01 THE LEAD    02 ART    03 DESIGN    04 IN THE CITIES
A furniture museum takes shape in an old warehouse
New drawings show a 1950s shoe warehouse turned into a museum around one long, top-lit hall.
A museum will restore a group portrait in public
From December, conservators will clean a 400-year-old portrait in an open gallery, for about a year.
A festival commissions a year of hand-made art
Seven exhibitions at seven universities, with more than a hundred artists taking part.
A new stadium with a garden on its roof
The 60,000-seat ground will have a planted roof and an open circle in the middle.
A painter’s night skies come to town
Her 1990s paintings of stars are shown here for the first time, until 19 December.
A complete set of mountain prints
All forty-six prints in one room, until 17 January.
An artist who peeled posters off city walls, until 14 February.
Three comic artists who changed the form
Original drawings from three pioneers, until 8 February.
An old manuscript back home on loan
Free to see at the national museum until 6 December.
